I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That number comes from #north-team, a channel Dana is in. On 20 Aug 2025 she posted 180 seats, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. I couldn't find the amendment document in the shared files, so I haven't checked the number against the signed copy. I told her June Osei-Lark has that copy if the deck needs to match it exactly.

A seat count is an account fact, not a money term, so it didn't need approval.
